reviewScope: Fresh bounded firsthand review of exactly the eight existing screenshot-manifest images, one at a time using functions.view_image.
decision: The eight displayed screenshots show readable full-page layouts, discernible formulas and complete figures 301-303 without visible clipping or overlap; zero-exercise surfaces agree with the bound native inputs.

observations: Chinese title, print-page metadata, complete prose flow, separators, all three figures and final zero-exercise link are visible.
Single centered reading column; paragraphs and displayed equations have clear vertical separation through the page end.
B = mu B_0, I = B - B_0, I = (mu - 1) B_0, equation numbers, inline Greek mu, subscripts and primes show no visible glyph truncation.

figureReview.notes: Rising initial curve bends toward saturation; both arrowed axes, origin label and subscripted horizontal-axis label are clear and separated from the curve and caption.

Closed hysteresis loop, initial branch and directional arrows are visible; positive and prime-bearing negative labels are distinguishable. The spaced B and subscript 0 remain legible, with no label collision.

Both vertically stacked panels are complete. Narrow soft-material and wider hard-material loops are visibly distinct; both headings, axes, origins and subscripted labels are clear, with no panel or caption overlap.
